The plate is roughly 26 cm across and spans about 345 px, so 1 cm is about 13 px.

The food is five pieces that look like roasted sweet potato chunks. Each is about 50 px, or roughly 3.5-4 cm, across. A chunk of that size is about 3.5 × 3 × 2.5 cm, or around 25 g. Five chunks come to about 125 g. Some pieces look smaller or darker, so I'll take about 110 g.

Sweet potato has about 90-110 kcal per 100 g when roasted, and roasting oil or caramelization adds a little. That gives about 120 kcal.
